senses.gloss:
ऐश्वर a. [ईश्वर-अण्] (री f.)
1
Belonging to or produced by a
lord or the Supreme Being,
majestic.
--2 Powerful, mighty.
--3
Belonging to Śiva; R. 11. 76.
--4
Supreme, royal.
--5 Divine.
--री N.
of Durgā.

ऐश्वर्यं [ईश्वर-ष्यञ्]
1 Supremacy,
sovereignty; एकैश्वर्यस्थितोपि
M. 1. 1; निशाचर˚.
--2 Might, power,
sway.
--3 Dominion.
--4 Affluence,
wealth, greatness; ˚मत्तेषु Ś. 5. 18.
--5 Superhuman power.
--6 The
divine faculties of omnipotence,
omnipresence &c.
